scope: K02 formula handling: source inspection only; no application code changes
findings: Native PDF text and OCR text are persisted separately; raw OCR is retained. Valid LaTeX returned by OCR is not intentionally flattened by the normalizer.
Retrieval chunks and embeddings consume chosenText strings, not formula objects or source page images.
Text-layer pages can bypass OCR. Neither analysis nor chunking preserves or validates mathematical structure explicitly.
Knowledge snippets are passed to the answer model as text, with no dedicated formula reconstruction or correctness verification.

Review panel displays escaped preformatted text. AiChat main page uses a custom Markdown renderer without math rendering; floating AiChatWidget uses MdPreview, whose math behavior was not runtime-verified.
Past K02 report records two formula-bearing pages truncated and excluded from indexing. This audit did not repeat that live run.

tests.reason: Read-only source explanation; no implementation change or fresh runtime/model verification requested

limitations: No particular failing user page was identified or inspected in the running application.
No claim of formula recognition accuracy or successful runtime math display.
